subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Should OpenClaw adopt persistent question summaries and user-triggered Skip as a required parity contract across the Control UI and native apps, while channels remain answer-only until a separate cancellation action exists?
rationale: The branch establishes a cross-client user-interaction contract rather than a narrow bug repair, and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit maintainer decision on the supported-surface boundary.

options.title: Adopt native/Web parity, qualify channels
options.body: Accept the proposed Control UI and native-app behavior, correct the docs to identify those supported surfaces, and leave channel cancellation for separately approved work.

options.title: Require channel Skip too
options.body: Expand the scope to add a typed channel cancellation action and channel-specific presentation before documenting Skip as universally available.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Retain the recovery and summary fixes but defer composer takeover or Skip parity until a smaller product decision is approved.

recommendation.title: Adopt native/Web parity, qualify channels
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed Control UI and native-app behavior, correct the docs to identify those supported surfaces, and leave channel cancellation for separately approved work.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR history ties this contributor most directly to the proposed cross-platform behavior and documentation contract.
